Container.Name: CharacterPerspectives
Container.Overview: Character turnaround generator. From one reference image (or a text description) it makes front, back, side, action, portrait, sitting, top-down and downed views plus a rotatable 3D model. Runs on a self-hosted ComfyUI (FLUX.1 Kontext, FLUX.2, Chroma, SD3.5, SDXL, SD1.5, with LoRAs; Pixal3D / TRELLIS-2 for 3D) or Gemini 2.5 Flash Image in the cloud. Models, LoRAs and API keys are set in the app's Settings and stored in models.xml in the Config path. Download All Characters backs up every character (a folder each, with views, 3D model, readable prompts and a restorable JSON); Import Character(s) restores them.
Container.Requires: A reachable ComfyUI instance (set COMFYUI_BASE) for local models and 3D. The 3D workflow needs the ComfyUI-TRELLIS2 / Pixal3D nodes and models.
Container.Description: Character turnaround views and 3D models from one reference image, via ComfyUI or Gemini.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web UI listens on.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Uploaded references, every generated view and 3D model, and saved workspaces.

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: models.xml: models, LoRAs, per-model switches and API keys (owner-only file). Never baked into the image.

Config.Name: COMFYUI_BASE
Config.Description: Base URL of the ComfyUI instance used for local models and 3D generation.
